source_kind: One exact connected Gmail metadata search on each of two profile-verified configured accounts; Root explicitly expanded read-only coverage before calls because the original private selector is not recoverable from public artifacts.
date_metadata_scope: Only email_ts metadata was consumed; date-only values retained when valid. No raw headers, addresses, message IDs, snippets, body or thread content was read or persisted.
queue_scope: Historical acknowledgement evaluation queue position; never rank. Current position/progress unverified.
read_scope: Aggregate subject-class and date metadata only across the two configured accounts; this cannot establish global result absence or an official score/rank/eligibility.
